S01: More than fifteen hundred years ago, in misty Britain lived a prince.
S02: It was Uther, brother of King Ambrosius and the bravest of all warriors.
S03: Thanks to his boldness, he always defeated his enemies.
S04: But he was not alone — his faithful friend was the great wizard Merlin.
S05: One night, Merlin followed the stars from his tower.
S06: Then in the sky appeared a great comet in the shape of a dragon.
S07: The shape of the dragon glowed like living fire.
S09: Shortly after, King Ambrosius died peacefully.
S10: Uther remained the only rightful ruler of Britain, exactly as Merlin foretold.
S11: In honor of the comet, Uther ordered a red dragon painted on his armor.
S12: Uther: "From this day, I shall be Pendragon."
S13: Pendragon rose above all others, and his name rang through the whole land.
S14: But the king needed a queen beside him.
S15: Uther sought the right heart to be his queen.
S16: She was called Igraine — beautiful, gentle and kind.
S18: At the wedding, the whole land rejoiced.
S19: Then came a word filled with joy — a child would be born in the palace.
S20: And so a child was born, whom they named Arthur.
S21: Little Arthur was peaceful, with eyes full of light.
S23: But on the border, from the shadows, enemies gathered.
S24: Above their camps the drums beat like distant thunder.
S25: Uther knew the battle was coming.
S27: Uther took his son in his arms, heavy with sorrow.
S28: He resolved to entrust Arthur to Merlin — the one who taught him and foretold everything.
S29: Merlin: "Do not worry. He will be safe with me."
S30: He would teach him literature and science, and perhaps a few magical tricks.
S32: Then Merlin vanished into the forest with the baby in his arms.
S33: Through the ancient forest, Merlin carried Arthur as one carries a treasure.
S34: From afar, the castle's portcullis dropped behind them.
S35: And Uther returned to the hall, where the army already waited.
S36: Uther: "Gather the men. We go to war."
S37: In the valley before the palace, the armies lined up in red ranks.
S38: Uther looked toward the forest, knowing his son was safe.
S39: With the red dragon ahead, Uther led the army toward the border.
S40: His determination burned brighter than any fire.
S41: Through the hills, the enemy armies came to meet him.
S42: Far in the forest, Merlin lit the stone cradle.
S43: The books and science opened before little Arthur like a firefly in the night.
S44: Merlin: "One day, you too will lead. But with wisdom, not with the sword."
S45: Pendragon led the army forward, and the red dragon shielded him with its wings.
S46: The banner with the dragon's head unfurled high above the battlefield.
S47: Thus the name Pendragon — "dragon's head" — remained to shine through the ages.
S48: And in the forest, the little seed of the future legend grew under the wizard's ward.
